title: docs(skills): line items in the parent's form are taught as a parent field group naming the child
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XC63go34oEMBFaBgqpoDC8N)_
Fixes #36224
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:照着技能搭「主表带明细」(发票带发票行、报价单带报价行)的作者和 AI,以前学到的是在明细的关联字段上打一个开关,结果新建表单里并没有明细;现在技能教的是在主表上加一个指向明细的分组,表单里才能直接录明细。应用的使用者无感,变的是技能教的内容。
- 为什么做:属于「对外发布的技能包教的内容要和运行时一致」这条线,替按技能生成应用的作者解决「发票、报价单的新建表单里录不了明细」的问题。
- 出错会怎样:只改技能文字、示例和评测用例,不动运行时;写错的话作者拿到的仍是一段不对的教法,直接回退这个合并即可。
- 要你做什么：这是受治理的技能文字改动（Tier H），复核记录判定它涉及权限相关的字样，不走低风险臂，需要你本人审阅批准后才能合并。L1 ACCEPT 7073837543，契约 PASS 7073893301（head c8770a8f）。

## What changes

State at head `c8770a8f` (two commits). The rule taught is the one the spec publishes on `fieldGroups[].relatedList` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) and on `inlineEdit` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`): the parent's entry form inlines a child where a field group of the parent names it, `inlineEdit` only picks how the rows are edited, and a child no group names is not inlined, whatever `inlineEdit` says.

Three published texts, each with one minimal example and the "without it, nothing changes" line:

- **`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, Inline Editing.** The opening paragraph taught `inlineEdit: true` on the child's FK as what makes the parent's form render the grid. It now says the form enters a child's rows where a field group of the parent names that child, that the group draws the table at its place in the record's details and in the entry form (below the form's fields when its sections name no field group), and that without the group the child is a tab and the form has no lines. The example is the parent's `fieldGroups` entry beside the child FK. The "set `inlineEdit` only for line items" paragraph is now "name only true line-item children; leave associations as tabs". The form-factor ladder stays where it was; its lead sentence reads "`inlineEdit` only picks how a placed child's rows are entered". The `'grid'` example's parent comment points at the group.
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, Master-Detail Forms.** Item 1 was "Relationship `inlineEdit` (default, zero UI config)". It is now "A parent field group naming the child (zero view config)", with the `fieldGroups` entry inline, the nothing-changes line, and the pointer to the data rule for the ladder. Item 2 (`subforms`) says "or inline a child no group names".
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, trap 2.** The trap title was "`inlineEdit` on the child's `master_detail` field". It is now "a parent field group naming the child", with the entry inline and the nothing-changes line; the "Add line" and `'bulk'` clauses are kept.

Evals (`skills/**/evals`, not ratcheted):

- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, case 2 ("Model invoices with line items…"): it required `inlineEdit` in the answer and its `expected_output` named "`inlineEdit` on that relationship". Both are removed; nothing about form entry is asserted there, because the prompt does not ask for it.
- Same file, new case 25 (「新建报价单时要在表单里直接录明细」, objects named in the prompt): `must_contain` is `fieldGroups` and `relatedList: 'quote_line'`; `must_not_contain` is `definePage`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, case 6 (invoice entry as a stepped form): its `expected_output` carried the same stale sentence as `list-views.md` item 1 and its `must_contain` held `inlineEdit`. The sentence now names the parent field group and the token is `relatedList`. This file is one more than the claim's file surface names; see Acceptance notes.

Changeset `.changeset/36224-inline-edit-form-group.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise measured at `a5a5312f`: the three places still taught the old rule (`relationships.md` 249-283, `list-views.md` 370-378, `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 48-52). Ratchet readings matched the dispatch: 4198/4203, 4448/4448, 2167/2272.
- In-place fix outside the claimed file surface: `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` case 6. Same defect (the same sentence, as an eval's expected answer), no other open PR head changes that file (overlap check above), same gate families. Left alone, the eval would grade the corrected text against the old answer.
- Data case 2 asserts nothing about form entry now. Whether a line-item model should get the placing group when the request does not ask for form entry is not said by the spec's descriptions, so neither the text nor that case teaches it.
- `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` is not paid in full inside the file (43 tokens, see Tests); the ratcheted total across the catalog is unchanged.
- Same family, not fixed here (reported to the seat, not filed):
  - `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`, three rows describe the inline-entry lint rules by `inlineEdit`. Measured on the built `@objectstack/lint` at this head: an `invoice_line` child with `inlineEdit: true` and no parent group still gets `relationship/line-items-inline-edit`, and one with no `inlineEdit` whose parent group names it gets none. The table says the opposite trigger. That file has 0 tokens of headroom.
  - `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, the `repeater` row points at "a child object (`master_detail`, `inlineEdit: 'grid'`)" for a typed list, with no group.
- Covered by PR 36222 (the tab and field-group text of the record page), not touched here: the "Detail-page related lists" part of `relationships.md`, `rules/record-page.md` and `evals/record-page.json`.
- `main` moved two commits after the branch point (to `c30ce97c`); neither touches `skills/**` or the ratchet, so the branch was not merged forward.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the first paragraph and example under "Inline Editing (Master-Detail Entry)": it carries the rule and the wording must not claim more than the spec's description.
2. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, item 1 under "Master-Detail Forms": the file sits 1 token under its ceiling.
3. `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, cases 2 and 25 token lists.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0 and prints `rules/relationships.md is 4156 tokens (ceiling 4203; headroom 47)`, `rules/list-views.md is 4447 tokens (ceiling 4448; headroom 1)` and `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md is 2210 tokens (ceiling 2272; headroom 62)`.
